producers.notes: Count reads QueueTelemetrySnapshot WHERE teamId = ctx.teamId. The worker sampler (services/worker/src/telemetry.ts:160) writes ONLY teamId:null rows; per-workspace rows are written solely by recordDbDerivedSnapshotsForWorkspace, called lazily from Home (command-center.service.ts:5990) when no snapshot exists within 240 minutes. So a workspace whose Home was opened goes ACTIVE 30 minutes later (threshold 30m) and stays ACTIVE until Home is opened again after 240m; a never-opened workspace has no rows -> value 0 -> RECOVERED. The condition measures Home visits, not the sampler.
